source: CBIC Tariff Unit, Customs Policy Wing — Guidance Document on Correlation of Customs Tariff between 2021 and 2022 (Annexure-II). Legal basis for the underlying renumbering: Fifth Schedule to the Finance Act, 2021, w.e.f. 01-01-2022 (HS-2022, the 7th edition of the Harmonized System). The correlation document itself is CBIC's own administrative aid, not a notification — it states it is a guide only.

correlationCodes.DF: the old code itself still exists, but its coverage narrowed (some of what it used to cover moved to a new code)
correlationCodes.NF: a brand-new code in the 2022 tariff, drawing from exactly one old code
correlationCodes.DP: the old code still exists with narrower coverage, and part of what moved is shared with other old codes (not a clean 1:1 split)
correlationCodes.NP: a brand-new code in the 2022 tariff, drawing from more than one old code
correlationCodes.OMITTED: the old code was deleted outright — the correlation document names no successor
